summary: The Ohio School Boards Association urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, opposing any proposal to eliminate or reduce E-Rate support for schools and libraries. The text argues against limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, emphasizing the importance of preserving and modernizing the program to ensure schools and libraries can continue to access affordable, reliable connectivity. It highlights the financial challenges that could arise from removing E-Rate support and the need to maintain access for diverse communities, particularly those with limited commercial broadband service. The text also stresses the importance of E-Rate in supporting educational needs an The stakeholders urge the preservation of the E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance in providing connectivity for schools and libraries to support educational needs.
